$comment: Every rendered verdict AND every rendered measurement on this page carries a marker, and every marker listed here has been forced false and watched go red. A mutation counts only when the unmutated baseline passed in the same session, the failure was that marker's OWN assertion, and the run served the mutated bundle (CI=1, port 4684, no reused server). e2e/verdicts.spec.ts fails on any rendered marker missing from this file, on any marker here the page no longer renders, and on any mutation whose killedBy test is not OBSERVED executing expectVerdict/expectClaim against that marker -- the helpers record every pair they run and the check reads that record, because the source scan this replaced was satisfied by a commented-out call. A text-only assertion says nothing about state and cannot be recorded as a kill, and an expectation read off the marker under assertion cannot be recorded either. Each entry below was re-run in an isolated `git archive` tree with its own node_modules symlink and CI=1, with the source md5 and the content-hashed bundle name recorded before and after, because a patch that never applied reports as a survivor. Every branch that writes a marker has its own mutation: markers with more than one code path carry more than one entry, because covering the marker is not the same as covering the branch.
